nativeProxyPreparation.control: The existing owner-root and 192-bit nonce control channel accepts action hold with an integer duration from 100 through 35000 milliseconds. The generated UUID, exact duration, held state, and parseable future deadline are acknowledged before use.
nativeProxyPreparation.behavior: Existing socket pairs pause both readable directions. New pairs are accepted but not piped until release. This keeps application buffering bounded by Node stream and operating-system socket backpressure. Automatic and explicit release use the same path. Repeated holds replace the timer. Disconnect and close clear the timer and destroy only proxy-owned sockets.
nativeProxyPreparation.runtimeGuard: Before clicking Sync, parse the returned holdDeadlineAt and require enough time to complete the bounded UI observations. Engage and acknowledge hold before Sync because bytes delivered before acknowledgement cannot be retracted.
nativeProxyPreparation.signals: Production proxy control performs no PID signal, process spawn, or external command execution. A private SIGSTOP design was independently rejected for PID-reuse and watchdog races and must not be used.

pendingNativeProcedure: Verify the exact fictional app executable, live Wry webview URL, profile, proxy root, and harness identity through the existing native fixture evidence.
Inject and verify G013 UID 5 before any compose send so the UIDNEXT guard remains intact.
Open and record one already cached message, then acknowledge a 35 second proxy hold before clicking visible Sync once.

While the hold remains active, reopen the cached Reader, open Compose, enter one uniquely identified fictional message, click Send exactly once, and verify optimistic Outbox state without a duplicate submission.
Resume before the deadline, verify Sync and realtime restart complete, then assert the single fictional send completes once and Outbox clears.
Preserve returned proxy states, deadline, visible Wry observations, final mailbox count, and application logs as native evidence.

findingsFixed: The signal-based private guard was rejected and replaced with authenticated in-process proxy control.
A hold command while disconnected now records a command-scoped error without terminating the proxy.
Hold acknowledgement now binds the strict UUID, requested duration, and a parseable future deadline.
independentReview.finalResult: GO for the scoped cached Reader, Compose, and bounded shared-proxy native exercise.

limitations: The final actual Wry held-Sync run is pending. Source and proxy preparation are not native acceptance.
The Reader source and planned native checks cover cached content only. Uncached body retrieval during held IMAP remains untested.
The native proxy is shared by both fictional accounts, so this run cannot prove account B progresses while account A is held. The deterministic source test covers cross-account lock isolation.
A send may wait for the same account operation lock. The native claim is optimistic Compose and Outbox responsiveness during hold, followed by exactly one completed send after release.
This bounded interaction is not a frame-latency or performance benchmark.
Physical sleep and wake remain an explicit user-declined waiver, not a pass.
The coordinated three-run full source baseline remains a separate pending gate.
